events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic death of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a true icon. Tupac's music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who redefined the electric guitar.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: The world lost a musical genius 56 years ago today. Jimi Hendrix's influence is still felt in every riff. What's your top Hendrix track?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks... pure timeless magic. What's your go-to?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Mad for it, Liam!
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! The one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo banger?

events.title: 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today. What does the song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember the Click Wheel?
angles.copy: 25 years ago, the iPod changed how we listened to music forever. Who still misses the satisfying click wheel and carrying all their tunes in one device?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 is pure cinematic gold. Who's your favourite Bond and what's your top Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A True Visionary
angles.copy: John Lennon would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese, famous for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: A Double Dose of Genius
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Forever a Champion
angles.copy: 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy are simply irreplaceable. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in 1965.

angles.name: A Turning Point
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles truly evolved their sound with this classic. Which track from the album is still a firm favourite?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon, who died in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering a Peacemaker
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His vision for a better world, through music and activism, lives on. What's his most important message for you?
